source.title: Augur's Ephemeral Orbs of Power — Wowhead item-side Looter Disenchanting table
source.author: Wowhead Looter cumulative player reports

notes: Wowhead original item-side cumulative Looter table for Augur's Ephemeral Orbs of Power (237716), epic cloth shoulders introduced in TWW patch 11.2; source crystal output row 1, one of 3 Refulgent Crystal rows from 157 reported item disenchant operations. Source rows may represent separate output qualities but source index does not reveal exact material ID or rank. Same studyKey/denominator on every row, not separate casts. Exact output item IDs, material units, positive-stack distributions, zero outcomes, sample epoch/build, gear version, character skill/spec and refund basis all unreported; no probabilities, min/max or gold EV inferred. Item introduction patch is not observation patch. WoWDB marks same item cannot be disenchanted (https://www.wowdb.com/items/237716-augurs-ephemeral-orbs-of-power); source eligibility conflict unresolved. Retain counts only as Looter reference; not current live EV.
